Clear signage and a challenging round
The night planner flagged a thought on pet arrivals, and the crew cheered

Quick check at the pet counter

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk kept the flow steady today. Travelers got clear guidance before departure, and the desk stayed warm, calm, and ready for last-minute notes. Every animal was met with patient attention from trained staff, and service changes went straight into the desk ledger without fuss. Keep the pace up, stay sharp on the handoff, and watch for any change in cabin needs. The work is routine, but the care behind it is not.
